intent: Compare old receipt total (excl. VAT) against today's catalog prices for the same products and decide if the difference stays within 3 EUR.
success_criteria: Receipt file in /uploads/ is located and read
Each receipt line item's product SKU/quantity and old unit price is extracted
Today's catalog price (excl. VAT) per SKU is fetched from product_variants
Old receipt total (excl. VAT) and today's total (excl. VAT) are computed and their absolute difference compared to 3 EUR
Answer is a yes/no with <YES> or <NO> token and references the receipt file

args.stdin: WITH receipt(product_sku, qty) AS (VALUES (:sku, :qty)) SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.product_name, pv.price_cents, pv.price_currency, r.qty, pv.record_path FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_sku = r.product_sku;

WITH receipt(product_sku, qty, old_unit_cents) AS (VALUES (:sku, :qty, :old_unit_cents)) SELECT SUM(r.qty * r.old_unit_cents) AS old_total_cents, SUM(r.qty * pv.price_cents) AS today_total_cents, ABS(SUM(r.qty * pv.price_cents) - SUM(r.qty * r.old_unit_cents)) AS diff_cents FROM receipt r JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_sku = r.product_sku;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections

answer_template.message: Old receipt ({receipt_path}) total excl. VAT = {comparison.old_total_cents/100} EUR. Today's catalog total excl. VAT = {comparison.today_total_cents/100} EUR. Difference = {comparison.diff_cents/100} EUR. Within 3 EUR threshold: {comparison.diff_cents <= 300 ? '<YES>' : '<NO>'}.
